import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format:
    <IP> - - [<date>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <size> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Example:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Jan/2024:12:34:56 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(\S+) - - '          # IP address
        r'\[(.*?)\] '          # date/time
        r'"(\S+) (\S+) (\S+)" '  # method, url, protocol
        r'(\d+) '              # status code
        r'(\d+) '              # response size
        r'"(.*?)" '            # referer
        r'"(.*?)"$'            # user agent
    )

    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        return {}

    ip, date, method, url, protocol, status, size, referer, user_agent = match.groups()

    return {
        "ip": ip,
        "date": date,
        "method": method,
        "url": url,
        "protocol": protocol,
        "status": int(status),
        "size": int(size),
        "referer": referer,
        "user_agent": user_agent,
    }
